methods.candidate_workaround: Validate changed-path parity and Git object identity at the named commit, then use the retained staged-review receipt for checkout-domain byte parity instead of equating checkout bytes with raw blob size.
methods.failure_signature: A source-manifest probe compared checkout byte counts to raw Git blob sizes and reported false mismatches despite exact path parity.
methods.recurrence_guard: Read hash_domain and checkout_bytes_domain before comparing sizes; never infer that the two byte domains are identical.
methods.rollback: Discard the false mismatch conclusion and retain the failed probe as an operational negative.
methods.scope_boundary: Source commit manifests and their retained staged-review receipts only; no source mutation and no independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Commit-manifest byte-domain discriminator
trigger_preconditions: A commit-local manifest declares checkout_bytes_domain separately from git_blob identity.

methods.candidate_workaround: Retain every raw candidate, inspect the matching source line, and classify only pattern-definition lines in the scanner itself as scanner-definition candidates rather than confirmed artifact leaks.
methods.failure_signature: The five-class privacy scanner classified its own private-path regular-expression literal as a confirmed hit.
methods.recurrence_guard: Report candidate and confirmed-hit counts separately; never discard scanner self-matches without exact line-context classification.
methods.rollback: Restore fail-closed classification if a candidate is outside an exact scanner-definition line.
methods.scope_boundary: Exact staged scanner-definition lines only; zero confirmed hits is not complete privacy assurance.

methods.candidate_workaround: Read the exact bounded current snippet, patch source-of-truth code first, then patch or regenerate the artifact with minimal exact context.
methods.failure_signature: A multi-file patch assumed generated JSON key order and failed exact-context verification before changing any file.
methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect generated key order before patching and avoid broad multi-file contexts that depend on inferred serialization order.
methods.rollback: No rollback is needed when apply_patch reports zero changes; retain the failed patch witness.
methods.scope_boundary: Owned x1 source and generated JSON only; no destructive rewrite.
methods.title: Generated-JSON narrow patch recovery
trigger_preconditions: A generated JSON artifact uses deterministic sorted keys.
The proposed patch context was inferred rather than read from the current file.

methods.candidate_workaround: Assert the frozen x1 phase-truth flags and x1 staged-review x2 path count, which remain valid after later additive lifecycle files exist.
methods.failure_signature: An x1 test inferred separation from the future worktree absence of x2 paths, so a valid later lifecycle would make the historical x1 assertion fail.
methods.recurrence_guard: Historical lifecycle tests must read frozen receipts, never infer prior state from the current later worktree.
methods.rollback: Restore the exact x1 test from its commit if the receipt-based assertion no longer matches the frozen evidence.
methods.scope_boundary: The assertion mechanism only; the x1 commit and frozen x1 receipts remain unchanged.
methods.title: Lifecycle-stable x1 assertion
trigger_preconditions: The same test module remains in the repository after x2 begins.

methods.candidate_workaround: Use one syntactically complete update hunk per file and validate each file header boundary before submitting the patch.
methods.failure_signature: A multi-file apply_patch payload inserted a new file header before closing the preceding update hunk and was rejected before mutation.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not leave a bare hunk marker before the next file header; prefer smaller multi-file patches when contexts differ.
methods.rollback: No rollback is required because patch parsing failed before mutation.
methods.scope_boundary: Patch grammar only; no repository content changed in the failed witness.
methods.title: Multi-file patch hunk grammar guard
trigger_preconditions: A hunk boundary is followed immediately by another file header without valid context.
